title: SkyBlock
tagline: DAO/Blockchain Management of ISO Compliant Cloud Computing Accounts
description:
We built hybrid of on-chain and cloud computing such that a SmartContract controls the cloud environment.  The access allowed by the contract fully dictates control of the cloud environment. 

What actually matters, is that the base of all cloud interactions is RBAC (roles based access control).  All cloud providers are focused on connecting a principal to a set of permissions. Who can do what?

The basis of all chain interactions begin with that same question.  Who can do what?  Which lends blockchain to be an ideal candidate for an idp (identity provider).
how_its_made: The project leverages Solidity to govern access to an AWS account.  When a wallet is granted an "admin role," a listening service provisions an account.  A password is generated and publicKey encrypted so it can be emailed to the user.  The encrypted password can be entered into a field on the page to be decrypted securely by the wallet.
